name: Screenshot Tidy
summary: Sweeps screenshots into your Screenshots folder, finding it on whichever Mac you're on.
story: Screenshots are field notes from the day: a chart, a bug, a building, a founder deck. They should be findable, not sprinkled across the Desktop like confetti.

launcher.long: Installs a background watcher that moves new screenshots into your Screenshots folder — resolved per Mac (iCloud Desktop or local), so it works wherever your iCloud Desktop lives.

installs.what: LaunchAgents com.amol.screenshot-tidy (+ clipboard helper) running ~/bin/screenshot-tidy.sh, ~/bin/screenshot-settings.sh and ~/bin/screenshot-paths.sh
installs.note: The agent needs Full Disk Access for /bin/bash to list the Desktop and iCloud Drive; without it it runs and moves nothing.
